pages.title: Unusual Passengers
pages.text: The right transport method helps relocate unusual creatures.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Make the lasso from shed snake skin. A suitably sized catfish swallows items/small creatures; bucket transport followed by a sea pickle releases its contents. Use only supported buckets for ordinary aquatic passengers.
